title: Final Expression for Cosine
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the expression for cos(theta/2) in terms of E0 and m.

title: Low Energy Limit
description: Important Criteria: The student should accurately determine theta in the low energy limit, showing the correct approximation and reasoning.

title: High Energy Limit
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly find theta in the high energy limit, demonstrating understanding of relativistic effects.

title: Conservation Laws
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply conservation of energy and momentum correctly in the context of the problem.

title: Units and Dimensions
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all quantities have consistent units throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common mistakes such as sign errors or misapplying conservation laws.
